data.name: Compulse
data.detailed_description:
ADAPT. PREDICT. SURVIVE.

Compulse is a fast-paced simultaneous tactical roguelite where evolving bio-organic entities clash inside compact alien arenas. Plan actions, predict enemy behavior, and watch every unit execute its decisions in real time through a unique WeGo-inspired combat system.

Lead a squad of living Compulsors through a hostile ecosystem shaped by mutation, biological fusion, and unstable evolution. Unlock new entities, evolve devastating builds, and survive increasingly dangerous runs in a world that feels alive, reactive, and constantly changing.

SIMULTANEOUS TACTICAL COMBAT

Every battle unfolds through continuous simultaneous action resolution. Timing, positioning, movement, and prediction are at the core of every encounter. Every decision matters, and even a single action can completely change the outcome of a fight.

  • Fast simultaneous turn-based gameplay with real-time resolution

  • Compact tactical arenas focused on readability and strategic positioning

  • Predict enemy behavior and outmaneuver evolving threats

  • Master enemy archetypes and learn their behavioral patterns

  • Continuous battles with no traditional turns or downtime

  • 3v3 squad-based combat built around synergy and tactical planning

GROW YOUR BROOD

Compulsors are not built — they are grown. Expand your roster by surviving dangerous encounters, defeating powerful enemies, and completing achievements that unlock new biological entities with unique identities, passives, and tactical roles.

Each Compulsor can be heavily customized during a run through mutations, abilities, supers, and relics, allowing you to constantly adapt your strategy to new threats and opportunities.

  • Unlock new playable Compulsors through progression

  • Build unique squads with distinct tactical identities

  • Equip abilities, supers, and relics during each run

  • Create powerful synergies and specialized builds

  • Make permanent strategic choices through a replacement-based upgrade system

ROGUELITE PROGRESSION WITH STRATEGIC DEPTH

Descend deeper into a branching biological ecosystem filled with battles, elite encounters, bosses, events, and irreversible choices. Every run introduces new combinations of upgrades, enemies, and tactical possibilities.

Failure is part of the evolution process. Unlock new entities, abilities, mutations, and increasingly challenging difficulty tiers as you master the systems of Compulse.

  • Branching node-based roguelite structure

  • Granular difficulty progression inspired by modern roguelite classics

  • Unlock new abilities, relics, units, and gameplay possibilities over time

  • Highly replayable runs with evolving builds and strategies

  • Experiment with different squad combinations and mutation paths

A LIVING BIO-ORGANIC WORLD

Explore a surreal alien ecosystem inspired by retro-futurism, psychedelic biology, and organic horror. Every environment, creature, and effect is designed around strong silhouettes, atmospheric visuals, and tactical readability.

Compulse blends vibrant colors, pulsating alien structures, and stylized bio-organic entities into a world that feels strange, hostile, and alive.

  • Distinct retro-futuristic bio-horror visual identity

  • Stylized organic creatures with evolving forms and mutations

  • Readable combat VFX designed for simultaneous tactical gameplay

  • Atmospheric environments inspired by gaseous, liquid, and solid biological states

  • Psychedelic soundtrack blending synthetic and organic soundscapes

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2048 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Specifications may change during development.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2048 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Specifications may change during development.
